name: Metamagic Spell Trigger
body:
You have learned how to manipulate the magic provided by spell-trigger items.

Prerequisite(s): Use Magic Device 10 ranks, any metamagic feat

Benefit(s): You can apply one metamagic feat you know to a spell generated by a spell trigger item, like a wand or staff, that you activate. You expend one extra charge for each spell level increase normally required by the metamagic feat. This level increase is not reduced by any class ability or feat for this purpose. You cannot increase the spell’s level above 9th with the metamagic applied. If there are insufficient charges to power the activation with the metamagic feat, the attempt fails and no charges are expended, however the action is still wasted.
